mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW 730d engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A replacement 3.0-litre diesel engine for a BMW 730d costs £1,200-£3,500 for a used unit (M57/N57), £3,200-£5,800 for a reconditioned unit, and £3,800-£8,500 for a fully rebuilt engine depending on generation. Supply and fit adds approximately £780-£1,040 in specialist labour (12-16 hours at £65/hr).

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of N57 timing chain failure in a 730d?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common sign is a rattling noise from the engine on cold start, particularly from the rear of the engine bay. Other symptoms include rough idle and poor performance, check engine light with timing-related fault codes, metallic debris in the oil, and catastrophic failure if ignored - chain snap destroys the engine.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a BMW 730d?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the generation and condition. An E65 730d is worth £1,500-£5,000 - a rebuilt engine may exceed the car's value. An F01 730d (£4,000-£9,000) makes replacement viable if the car is otherwise in good condition. A G11/G12 730d (£15,000-£40,000+) easily justifies a replacement engine.

mainEntity.name: How long does a BMW 730d engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most BMW 730d engine replacements take 2-4 days for supply and fit at a specialist garage. The M57/N57/B57 straight-six is a relatively straightforward engine to remove and refit on the 7 Series chassis.

mainEntity.name: Do BMW 730d replacement engines come with a warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes - all rebuilt and reconditioned BMW 730d engines supplied through EnginesMarket include a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. Used engines typically have a 3-6 month warranty depending on the supplier. Extended warranty options are available with some specialists.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the 730d, 740d and 750d engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 730d uses a single-turbo 3.0-litre straight-six diesel producing 218-286 hp. The 740d uses a twin-turbo version producing 313-340 hp. The 750d uses a quad-turbo B57S producing 400 hp. Engines are not interchangeable between variants without significant ECU and hardware changes.

historyTimeline.h2: BMW 7 Series 730d - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The BMW 730d has served as the entry-level diesel flagship of the 7 Series range since the E65 generation, offering a compelling blend of refinement, torque and fuel economy. Over four generations - E65, F01, G11 and G12 - the 730d has been powered by three successive 3.0-litre straight-six diesel families: M57, N57 and B57.

milestones.description: M57D30, 3.0-litre inline-six turbodiesel, 218 hp (160 kW) / 500 Nm, launch of E65 730d
M57D30TU2 (facelift), 231 hp (170 kW) / 520 Nm, E65 LCI update
N57D30, 245 hp (180 kW) / 540 Nm, F01 7 Series launch
B57D30A, 265 hp (195 kW) / 620 Nm, G11 730d launch; N57 phased out
B57D30A (LCI update), 286 hp (210 kW) / 650 Nm, G11/G12 mild-hybrid

commonProblems.h2: BMW 7 Series 730d Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW 730d has been powered by three generations of 3.0-litre straight-six diesel - M57, N57 and B57 - each with its own reliability profile. While the M57 is broadly regarded as robust, the N57 is well-documented for timing chain issues, and the B57 (particularly early examples) can suffer from EGR cooler problems. Rebuilt engines supplied through EnginesMarket include upgraded timing chain components (N57), refreshed EGR systems (B57) and a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Timing Chain Failure - Why the BMW 7 Series 730d N57D30 Wears Prematurely
problems.rootCause: Timing chain stretch and tensioner wear, particularly on pre-2013 models. The chain is located at the rear of the engine, making inspection and replacement labour-intensive.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner
repairOptions.longevity: Catch it early - before chain skips or breaks

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, new timing chain components, upgraded tensioner, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If chain has already failed and caused internal damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical 730d varies significantly by generation. An E65 730d (2002-2008) is worth approximately £1,500-£5,000; an F01 730d (2008-2015) sits at £4,000-£9,000; and a G11/G12 730d (2015-present) holds £15,000-£40,000+ [THIRD-PARTY - Parkers/Auto Trader market observation]. - Vehicle worth under ~£5,000: repair or used engine typically makes more sense than a full rebuilt unit. - Vehicle worth ~£5,000-£8,000: evaluate both; reconditioned is viable if keeping the car 2+ years. - Vehicle worth ~£8,000-£15,000: reconditioned/rebuilt usually justifies the premium via warranty and reliability. - Vehicle worth £15,000+: replacement cost is typically small relative to vehicle value.
problems.recommendation: If your 730d has a rattling timing chain on cold start, act immediately - ignoring it will lead to catastrophic failure. A specialist timing chain replacement (£1,900-£2,800) is the most cost-effective solution if caught early. If the chain has already snapped or the engine has jumped timing, a rebuilt engine with upgraded components is the only reliable fix.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt N57D30 BMW 7 Series 730d engine prices

problems.h4: EGR Cooler Failure - BMW 7 Series 730d B57D30A / B57D30B Coolant Leak
problems.rootCause: The EGR cooler can develop internal leaks, allowing coolant to enter the exhaust system. This can lead to white smoke, coolant loss and potential fire risk - BMW issued recalls for this issue.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace EGR cooler, gaskets, flush cooling system
repairOptions.longevity: First-line fix - check if recall covers your VIN

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, new EGR cooler, DPF service, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If overheating has caused head gasket or block damage

problems.recommendation: Check your VIN against BMW's EGR cooler recall before spending any money - many B57-equipped 730ds are covered. If not covered, a specialist EGR cooler replacement is straightforward and significantly cheaper than a full engine replacement. If the car has overheated, get a compression test before deciding.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt B57D30A/B BMW 7 Series 730d engine prices

problems.h4: DPF Clogging - BMW 7 Series 730d Urban Driving Issues
problems.affectedModels: BMW 7 Series 730d (all generations, all engine codes)
problems.rootCause: The 730d's diesel particulate filter relies on sustained motorway speeds for passive regeneration. Short, stop-start urban journeys prevent this, leading to clogging, warning lights and reduced performance.

repairOptions.longevity: First step - works if DPF is lightly clogged

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: New DPF, associated sensors and full service
repairOptions.longevity: If DPF is cracked or beyond cleaning

problems.recommendation: DPF issues are preventable with regular motorway driving and proper maintenance. If you're mainly using your 730d in town, consider a petrol or hybrid alternative. If the DPF is clogged, start with a forced regeneration - it's the cheapest option. Only replace the DPF if it's physically damaged or cleaning fails repeatedly.
